reviews.text:
A very bad experience. My dog ​​is in excellent health despite being old for her breed. We take good care of her: monthly brushing and grooming twice a year, as recommended by our veterinarian. After our previous groomer left, we had to miss a session due to lack of time and, more importantly, the difficulty in finding a professional who would accept large dogs.

We made an appointment at "Boule d'amour" three months ago, after a phone consultation and sending photos of our dog. Aware that grooming large dogs takes more time, we booked well in advance to allow the salon to prepare, and we are used to paying the corresponding price (requested in cash, of course...).
Upon arrival, we had a surreal 15-minute discussion, mainly consisting of reprimands and baseless arguments, culminating in the announcement that grooming wasn't possible... because our dog wasn't groomed enough! This is the height of absurdity for a grooming salon. With an appointment booked three months in advance, an entire afternoon reserved, and an unlimited budget, I find this last-minute announcement unprofessional and, above all, disrespectful.

In my line of work, thankfully we don't turn away a patient simply because they're too sick. It's a shame that this logic doesn't apply here.
So, if you don't have €90 to spend every two months to ensure your dog looks impeccable upon arrival, save yourself the trip. You'll avoid wasting your time... just like I did.

Fantastic first experience for our 5-year-old corgi puppy who needed a good grooming and detangling before summer. The groomer took care of him for almost two hours with patience and gentleness, and even managed to remove a tick that had gotten into his ear the day before. Our dog came out looking amazing, thank you again! 👌 I highly recommend her and will definitely be back.

I brought my little adopted Yorkshire Terrier in for her first grooming session. The lady was very patient with her. The cut was wonderful, I'm very happy, and I recommend her to everyone I know without hesitation ❤️ Until next time
So glad I found this groomer! My 13-year-old dog looks brand new after their visit. They even took him for a little walk while I waited to pick him up. I highly recommend them!
A huge thank you for your warm welcome, your kindness, and for taking the time to explain everything to me. Stéphanie is a competent professional who is passionate about her work. Thank you again.

Willys and Oopper were delighted with Stéphanie's care. They had revitalizing baths for their coats and, most importantly, left feeling so happy… a lovely and very competent young woman who does her job with passion!! What more can I say? Simply perfect! 🫶🫶😀😀 …
Perfect for my two little ones! Stéphanie is a gem of kindness, she loves her job, and the pups are very happy with her special care. See you soon from Willys and Oopper. Kisses!

Hello, this woman refused to cut my Spitz's fur, claiming that you shouldn't shave a Spitz, when all you had to do was trim its fur with scissors... perhaps she doesn't know how to trim a Spitz's fur with scissors! I still paid 75 euros for shampooing and drying a dog weighing less than 2 kg! I won't be going back!
Excellent experience! My dog ​​arrived terrified but left calm and looking beautiful! I highly recommend it.
They took such good care of my dog ​​Loulou for the first time! Thank you!

A JOY!!!
My 3.5-year-old dog had, in fact, never been groomed.
In the street, people admire my little Havanese, marveling at the softness of his coat! Of course! He'd never had the right product!
Well done for your expertise, attentiveness, and professionalism.
See you soon and thank you.

Excellent grooming salon with quick availability. Stéphanie and Lola are very thorough. They took the time needed to care for my pet, who was shedding heavily—the walls, floor, and bathtub will certainly remember it! Bring cash to pay (there's an ATM nearby if you prefer). A price range can be given before the service, and the final price may vary depending on the condition of your pet, etc. Thank you for your work!

I highly recommend them – they were wonderful with my dog, who is sometimes afraid of grooming, but he was perfect and they were so kind to him. One of the employees had quoted us a price and, despite it taking two hours longer than expected, she kept the price as is.

Excellent advice for my little Pomeranian… very pleasant and professional, I will be back.
Thank you very much.
It was perfect, thank you!

First time bringing my dog ​​to this salon and honestly, I have nothing but praise! The welcome and professionalism were top-notch! My dog ​​came out beautifully clean and radiant!

I highly recommend them!

I highly recommend this groomer!

I went there after a terrible experience at another salon, so I was quite apprehensive… and I'm so glad I trusted this groomer!

From the moment you arrive, you can tell she genuinely loves her job and animals. She's gentle, attentive, professional, and takes the time to ensure everything goes smoothly.
My pet was groomed perfectly, respectfully, and without any stress, and the result is simply impeccable.
It's so refreshing to find someone so passionate, caring, and attentive after a disappointing experience.
I wholeheartedly recommend this salon and will definitely go back. Thank you again for your work and your kindness! 💖🐾
Groomer to absolutely avoid! I took my small dog in for grooming, picked him up with his tongue cut out, and they called me back to pick him up again under the pretext that he had knots.
The owner is amazing! My dog ​​felt great, and she trimmed his nails perfectly. I highly recommend this groomer and salon; it's very clean and she's very professional.

I highly recommend this salon. The woman who groomed my 5-month-old Pomsky was very friendly and professional. It was my first time taking my dog ​​to a groomer, and she was very reassuring. You can see from her work that she's passionate about her job!
top-notch

Thank you to Stéphanie for grooming Snoopy!
Very professional. Snoopy looks gorgeous and smells wonderful 😍😍 We'll be back! …

A huge thank you to Stéphanie, who is absolutely fantastic! She knows how to make our little dog feel comfortable and confident from the moment he arrives. Highly professional, she is a true expert in her field, whether it's grooming, haircuts, or full care. You can tell she really knows her stuff. Stéphanie is also incredibly sweet, gentle, and passionate. I recommend her 100%! Thanks to Snoopy :)
I brought my young cocker spaniel, who was full of knots, and they worked a miracle. Friendly, gentle, and very competent.

I entrusted Sunny, my 4-year-old Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, to her.

The groomer was pleasant and attentive to my needs.
The work was meticulous.
She uses excellent products.
Sunny had a magnificent coat and smelled lovely.
We'll be back.

The welcome was truly incredible. It took me a long time to get an appointment due to my own poor planning, but it's definitely worth the effort.

Excellent service and love for dogs!
Saphir (chihuahua) delighted with her experience.

A perfect groomer who asked me the right questions for my little dog's first appointment. My dog ​​had never been groomed before, and she wanted to make sure she wouldn't be traumatized. She was incredibly gentle and understanding. My dog ​​came out looking beautiful, full of joy, and just as delighted as I was with the experience. I highly recommend her!

I had a wonderful time at this grooming salon and received a very warm welcome. The groomer is very professional, thorough, and honest. You can tell she truly loves animals and takes great care in her work. I highly recommend this salon! 🐶 …

A groomer who's passionate about her work is rare. I booked an appointment for my dog ​​after seeing the grooming she did on a colleague's dog. I'm very proud of the result and will definitely go back. Very friendly and professional. Don't hesitate, you won't regret it. 😊 …

This young groomer was recommended to me, and I'm so glad I made an appointment for my apricot miniature poodle. I've been three times now, and I'm never disappointed. She's very friendly, professional, and attentive—everything my dog ​​needs to feel confident. I highly recommend this grooming salon.
Excellent welcome and top-notch care for my little dog Foxy, I will definitely come back, thank you!
Very professional! I recommend her!!

A truly exceptional groomer! She took wonderful care of my 12-year-old dachshund, who needed a special trim. Very attentive to his back problems, she was gentle, patient, and highly professional. My dog ​​was pampered and felt completely at ease from beginning to end. I highly recommend her; thank you again for your kind attention and excellent service!
Very welcoming and my dog ​​is so handsome :)

Top-notch groomer!!! Very kind, welcoming, and super gentle with my two dogs.

I recommend her 100%! 😁👌 …

First time at Boule d’Amour because my previous groomer retired.

A very warm welcome, smiling and pleasant.
The price was quoted upfront.
She made me laugh because she didn't want to give me back my dog, she thought he was so great! 😅 I highly recommend Boule d’Amour; she's very professional and dedicated to my dog's well-being. She perfectly adapted to my instructions regarding the length of the haircut. I'll be delighted to entrust my dog ​​to her again in three months! 👍
I completed my internship, which was very enriching. The groomer is passionate, and it shows. She listens attentively to both the animal and its owner. Thank you again for this experience.

The service exceeded my expectations.

This young woman is passionate about her work! I was very surprised that for our first appointment she offered to let me stay for two hours with my four-legged friend! The work she did was simply amazing; I've never seen my dog ​​so silky! We've finally found our groomer! Even though Olly, our 6-year-old Golden Retriever, grumbles for it to stop, she's never been so happy with her beautiful coat!
I highly recommend her!
Marie

Tango, a 3-year-old cocker spaniel, had his first grooming session at Boule d'Amour. He's traumatized by grooming.

Everything went very well, Tango is reassured and looks fantastic.
Thank you again.

Professional! Highly recommended!
Thank you for Lola 🤍🐶 …

I arrived five minutes before my appointment and was immediately met with an unwelcoming attitude from the person outside. Despite needing my cocker spaniel groomed, I went into the salon. I said hello, but received no response. The groomer, in a very harsh tone, asked me to keep my dog ​​away from another, very friendly dog ​​and put him on the table. I complied. She then aggressively asked me, "What do you want, you idiot?" After I explained what I wanted, she abruptly declared that she couldn't groom him because of a flea, claiming he hadn't had one before coming in. This was surprising and concerning, especially given that we are in Marseille.
Overall, the experience was extremely unpleasant. The individual displayed a complete lack of communication and respect for the customer. Not only did she not have time to disinfect, but no effort was made to be polite or respectful. Why don't you just come back flea-free when Marseille is clean? I strongly recommend this person learn the basics of communication etiquette, including greeting customers with a smile and showing respect.

And even less so for the dog!
First time at the groomer for my dog ​​and everything went very well. Great welcome and I'm delighted with the result.
My dog ​​is afraid of water and noise, but she was able to put him at ease and calm him down. Everything went very well. She listened attentively and gave a warm welcome. I highly recommend her.
Absolutely fantastic, great welcome and thank you again!
A truly amazing person, very attentive, I highly recommend them!

This is the second time I've brought my Maltese, and she always comes out looking beautiful!
They listened carefully to what I wanted and gave great advice!
I highly recommend them.
Very good experience
Very attentive to my dog's well-being, who was perfectly and gently groomed. A competent person to recommend.
It was Vanille's first grooming session, my 3-month-old Morkie puppy, and everything went very well. The professionalism, combined with kindness and gentleness, was spot on! I recommend them 100%!

Top-notch groomer, super warm and attentive welcome. It was my dog's first grooming session and I'm delighted.
I highly recommend her.

Hello

High-quality, meticulous work, and the hair removal was done correctly.

First hair removal on January 20th for a long-haired Jack Russell, after more than 8 months without grooming. A major job, €90 (I thought it was a bit expensive, but the work was very well done).

We returned at the beginning of June after just under 6 months, for a similar service, but this time at €125, which is 40% more than the last time…

I'm not questioning your work or the time you spent, but there needs to be more transparency regarding your prices.

Unfortunately, because of these prices that fluctuate more than the price of Bitcoin, we won't be returning.
A groomer who gives excellent advice, knows the breeds well, and isn't just trying to make a quick buck. I highly recommend her.

First grooming session for my dog.

A very warm welcome.
My little Milo left happy.
A dedicated and professional groomer who loves animals, and they love her back. A very good experience, I highly recommend! Second grooming session, just as satisfied, and Milo is thrilled with his groomer. He adores her!!
I highly recommend them! They were kind and professional. My dog ​​felt comfortable right away! I'm so happy with this first experience and I'll definitely be back. Thanks again!

An exceptional groomer, very professional and lovely.

You can entrust your dog to her without hesitation. My big Chopin looked so beautiful and soft. I even got a photo of him during his grooming session. Well done, sweetie, and thank you, we'll definitely be back.

Excellent groomer! A fantastic job.

We'll be back with Alfred.
Amazing groomer! She's so sweet with the animals, and they can tell! Mine was so comfortable she even took a nap while she was being dried! :) Thank you, and see you soon!

First time at Boule d'Amour for my princess Inoha, and I'm definitely not disappointed.
The groomer took her time with Inoha, who is quite timid, but she knew how to win her over, and when I picked her up, she wasn't stressed at all.

It's so nice to know there are people who love our four-legged friends as much as I do.
Don't hesitate, you can go there with your eyes closed. 🐾🐾🐕

A fantastic grooming salon!

I took my dog ​​Laika in for a grooming session, and I'm thrilled with the result! The team is professional, gentle, and very attentive to the animals' needs. My dog ​​came out perfectly clean and beautifully groomed. You can tell they truly love their work and take care of each animal as if it were their own. I highly recommend them and will definitely be back!
Exceptional service, thank you again!

It was my little darling's first time, and honestly, it couldn't have been better. Passing through Marseille, I checked the Google reviews, and I'm so glad I did. A warm welcome, a kind, professional, and caring person—it was a pleasure for both my dog ​​and me. I highly recommend it! My dog ​​came out feeling so soft and cuddly; I'm thrilled. A truly fantastic experience.

I highly recommend this groomer; they take their time with our furry friends to reassure and pamper them. It was our first time taking our puppy to the groomer, and the experience was smooth and enjoyable. Vanda came out looking transformed and gorgeous, and she wasn't stressed at all when we left her. I'm delighted, and we'll definitely be back :)

The haircut is completely unsuitable for my dog; he looks like a different breed altogether. The owner insisted she would give him a cut that suited his breed, but instead he looks like a poodle, which is nothing like it.

An absolutely perfect experience! A warm welcome, exemplary professionalism, and incredible attentiveness. Knowing I was a little stressed, she took the time to reassure me by sending photos at each stage of the grooming process—a real bonus that made all the difference! But most importantly: my little guy, who is usually very anxious about being groomed, was this time completely relaxed, happy, and confident. I never would have imagined seeing him so serene! A huge thank you for your gentleness and kindness. I recommend her 1000% and will definitely be back!
Thank you so much for your professionalism. ❤️

The groomer is amazing! She really knows her stuff! My dog ​​Stoubidou was so happy with his time at the salon!

You can go there without hesitation!

It was my very first time, and honestly, what a wonderful discovery! My little girl came out looking gorgeous, so soft and with a great hairstyle, I'm so, so happy! A huge thank you for your kindness and professionalism, I loved it! I'll definitely be back. See you very soon!

Thank you, Stéphanie, for your professionalism and gentleness with our beloved pets 🐾❤️. For our first appointment in June, I have a Maltese named Fifi, and I was pleasantly surprised by your warm welcome and patience. You listen to our needs and give excellent advice. Our dogs can only be calm and beautiful in your hands 😉🐾. Fifi's haircut was superb 👍🐾. Thank you 🐾🤗. I highly recommend Stéphanie.
My 6-month-old baby Duck had his first grooming and he is now beautiful again and, most importantly, white instead of grey. I highly recommend this very pleasant and professional person.

Thank you so much!
I'm very happy with the treatment Luke received from you.
I highly recommend you!
We'll be back soon!
Thank you for taking the time to cut Isaac's nails without prior notice and with such gentleness and kindness.

Yesterday, my first grooming session at Boules d'Amour...and what a result, especially considering we came from so far away! LOL My little darling is reborn, everything is perfect, the contact between him and me is great, nothing to say, everything is great, go there without hesitation!!
First grooming session for my dog, whom I thought was timid, but she was pampered with professionalism and kindness! I highly recommend!

Great, I highly recommend!
Pleasant welcome, super quick appointment, very gentle touch; my kitten immediately felt at ease. 👍🏼 …

First grooming session for my dog ​​today. The welcome was very warm and friendly; the groomer was very pleasant and accommodating, and clearly loves animals. The grooming itself was excellent, and great care was taken to ensure my dog's well-being. I will definitely be back!

We took Djinn, our 7-month-old English Cocker Spaniel, for her very first grooming session. Stéphanie was very professional and attentive to our requests and questions. Djinn was a little scared of the high-velocity brush, but Stéphanie took the time to reassure her and give her some treats.
The result is perfect, a big thank you! 🐾
We came today to have our cat's nails trimmed. The appointment was quick, and the woman was very kind and professional. We'll gladly come back! A big thank you to her!

I 100% recommend them! My two Papillon Chihuahuas were returned to us looking beautiful and completely stress-free.

Thank you so much to Boule d'Amour Grooming!
I brought my dog ​​in to have her nails trimmed. The welcome was very warm; the owner is extremely kind, professional, attentive, and focused on the animal's well-being. I highly recommend it!

Perfect! Stephanie is competent, gentle, and very professional!
Bravo and thank you from Kali, the 24-year-old cat!
Excellent groomer, very attentive to her animals. My Samoyed came out looking great. Thank you for your excellent work. 👌 …

Great experience! Rio arrived stressed but left much calmer! And most importantly, looking so handsome 🐶
Thanks, Stéphanie!
I promise he'll check you out next time ✋

Absolutely satisfied with Stéphanie's service.

I recommend her.
Excellent service. My poodle is gorgeous!! Thank you so much.
You can go there with your eyes closed! A true animal lover :)

After spending a few days with Stéphanie in her living room for a documentary film project, we can assure you that she works meticulously and with great tenderness towards animals! Thank you, Stéphanie :)
I came to have my dog's nails trimmed. Thank you so much for your professionalism and kindness.

First grooming session for my 5-month-old puppy, Vanille. Stéphanie was very attentive and responsive. The result is fantastic; everything was done gently and professionally. I highly recommend her and will definitely be back :)
Absolutely fantastic!!

Having completed an internship at Boule d'Amour, I can assure you that the well-being of the animal is the groomer's top priority.
Dogs and cats are well treated, and clients are warmly welcomed. Dogs are groomed thoroughly while respecting their individual needs.

My little Maine Coon kitten's first grooming session!

Thank you so much for taking such good care of her! 🤗 …

My cocker spaniel said to me as we were leaving, "Daddy, I'm so, so handsome!!!"
Perfect welcome
Impeccable punctuality

This is the first time we've taken our Lhasa Apso to Stéphanie. It's PERFECT. We recommend her 100%. The scissor cut was perfect. The welcome was excellent, and the handling of our long-haired puppy was also top-notch. Stéphanie, don't change a thing!

See you very soon for our baby Nanou's second appointment.

Karine Russo and Narayan

We brought our long-haired cat in a few weeks ago for his first proper grooming session. The owner is super friendly and a true professional; she knows exactly how to handle cats.
I highly recommend her!
A top groomer, my little one is well pampered, don't hesitate to bring your animals

On my daughter's recommendation, I took my cat to Boule d'Amour for his first grooming session. He was treated by a true professional, gentle and attentive, with a wonderful rapport with animals. I highly recommend them.

Fantastic experience! The groomer was amazing and so attentive to my polka-dotted friend! Ninja came back even more beautiful and sweet than before, and thrilled with the experience. I highly recommend her! Ultra-professional service and very accommodating with my last-minute appointment.
Stephanie took great care of our 8-month-old Vicky (English Cocker Spaniel).

Today I just came from the grooming salon for my cat. I saw a professional at work; she takes her time with our little animals, is very competent and friendly.
I thank her and I will definitely go back.

My previous groomer closed down, and I'd like to find a new one for Enzo. While searching on Google Maps, I came across Stéphanie, and the first experience went very well. She's very meticulous and patient… Enzo is very happy.

Fantastic experience! While in Marseille, my little Chibi really needed some pampering, and she's never looked so beautiful ❤️ A very warm welcome and professional service, a real pleasure. Thank you again!
I highly recommend her: the groomer is very gentle and you can tell she's passionate about her work. My dog ​​and I have adopted her!

A very professional and competent groomer. It was my 8-year-old Pomeranian's first time, and everything went well despite his and my own stress ;). He came out looking brand new! I highly recommend her!

A very welcoming groomer who knows how to ensure the well-being of the animal.
I highly recommend her! 👍 …

They were amazing with my little Yorkie for her first grooming session! She was so gentle and patient, took all the time she needed to put her at ease, and gave her lots of treats 🥰 I highly recommend this salon …

Fantastic experience at this grooming salon! It was the first time my 3-year-old cat, with his long, very matted fur, had been groomed and bathed. The groomer, with great gentleness and expertise, managed to soothe, wash, brush, and leave my cat feeling wonderfully soft! I highly recommend it!

I highly recommend this groomer! She's very professional and attentive to your pet's needs. It was quick and efficient, and my little furball came out looking fresh and beautiful.

Plus, the groomer offers excellent advice on how to care for your furry friends. We'll definitely be back. ✨🐶
First appointment for my little Shih Tzu, I've finally found a good grooming salon... I'm delighted with this professional's work

I highly recommend her. Very friendly and professional, she took great care of my dog ​​while putting her at ease. The grooming is impeccable, and you can tell she truly loves animals. I will definitely be back!
So glad I found Stefanie!! Excellent service, very friendly and pleasant, and also very caring with animals; she took great care of my beagle. I highly recommend her!!!
Absolutely perfect! My pups are all beautiful and clean ❤️
Thank you again for your kindness and patience, Vadim is delighted with his new haircut 🧸😂 We will gladly come back. …
Thank you so much, my little ones are adorable 🐩🐶 I'll come back when I'm back in Marseille …
Stéphanie does her job with love, awesome!! 🫶 …

Top-notch experience!
Unwavering professionalism.
Patient, available, responsive, and reassuring! I highly recommend this salon; it's worthy of a 4-star rating.
My Jack Russell left with such soft fur!
Gives great advice.
See you soon!
